property_summary: After deploying C as owner=address(0), calling transferOwnership(alice) as alice should fail (require) due to onlyOwner modifier, but the buggy version writes msg.sender to owner before the modifier check? Actually both have modifier; the bug is that in the second version, transferOwnership sets owner = msg.sender instead of owner = newOwner, so after a legitimate owner call to transferOwnership to bob, owner becomes msg.sender (owner) not bob, breaking the expected transfer. Concrete: deploy (owner=address(0)), prank bob (random address) call owned() will revert (since owner is 0). Then prank address(0) (default caller) call transferOwnership(bob) — in reference, owner becomes bob, in buggy version owner stays address(0). Then assert owner is bob.
